description: This file is a shell script containing automated tests for Git commands, specifically testing the '--set-upstream' option of 'git fetch' and 'git pull'. It sets up repositories, runs commands, and verifies configurations and behaviors.

methods.name: check_config
methods.description: Checks if a Git branch's remote and merge configuration match expected values.

methods.name: check_config_missing
methods.description: Verifies that the branch configuration entries are missing.

methods.name: clear_config
methods.description: Removes remote and merge configuration entries for specified branches.

methods.name: ensure_fresh_upstream
methods.description: Creates a new bare Git repository named 'parent' to simulate an upstream repository.
